metadata.validation_scope: KRX PIT large-cap research-window execution regression, not full-history factor validation
metadata.universe_rule: Original historical signal-day KOSPI/KOSDAQ observations, positive observed Volume on signal; Marcap>=10 trillion KRW retained
metadata.capital_basis: initial_capital is independent for each decile
metadata.scope: Historical source-panel price/market-cap research; not a total-return or complete corporate-action study
metadata.risk_notice: No present-day constituent filter; historical completeness and official legal security-state mapping unverified. Cash dividends/rights/delisting recoveries not reconstructed. Fixed costs illustrative, not certified historical tax rates.
metadata.research_assumptions: Continuous pro-rata rights marked at underlying close (conditional haircut1.0), virtual settlement at official listing close, distribution taxes excluded; Net includes trading costs only; not broker account or PIT certification.
metadata.predeclaration: 2026-10-18 before any new strategy NAV; immutable experiment input
metadata.execution_model: Whole order waits for every currently tradable share position and target. Original signal frozen; no partial fill, cancellation, replacement, cash advance or future execution quote. Verified event transfers change required shares; unknown rights/spin-offs BLOCK.
metadata.target_model: Targets allocate liquid NAV only; unpaid rights and receivables stay outside trading budget; own Gross/Net books and post-cost liquid allocation.
metadata.liquidity_rule: Positive observed signal and actual execution volume; no extra liquidity floor; unknown observations fail
metadata.cash_distribution_basis: Cash dividends not reconstructed; NOT total return; distribution taxes excluded
metadata.minimum_population_policy: Deciles require >=10; top10 requires >=10; never reduce count or period
